blocks.text: A system of rules and principles for the structure of a language, or of languages in general.
The study of the internal structure of morphemes (words and their semantic building blocks).
The study of the structure of phrases, sentences, and language.
A method of representing a language or the sounds of language by written symbols.
A set of symbols and marks which are used to clarify meaning in text by separating strings of words into clauses, phrases and sentences.
The set of all words and phrases in a language; any unified subset of words from a particular language.
The relative emphasis or prominence given to a certain syllable in a word or to a certain word in a phrase or sentence.
Exercises: which term each definition is of. Review Terms, at the foot of the page, drills this module's terms.
